begin_of_turn_query.content: I plan to book a flight from Crescent Hollow to New York, aimed at a business endeavor. Utilize my typical credit card (ID=card_6789) and access token 'abc123xyz' for the payment. Schedule it for economy class on November 12th 2026, making sure my frequent flyer discount is applied, ensuring the total fee is $850.
